description: This file defines extension methods for the ISiloBuilder interface to configure Redis as a grain storage provider within an Orleans application. It provides methods to add Redis storage as default or named storage, with optional configuration parameters.

classes.name: RedisSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for ISiloBuilder to configure Redis storage.

methods.name: AddRedisGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Configures Redis as the default grain storage provider with specified options.

methods.name: AddRedisGrainStorage
methods.description: Configures Redis as a named grain storage provider with specified options.

methods.name: AddRedisGrainStorageAsDefault (overload)
methods.description: Configures Redis as the default grain storage provider with optional configuration builder.

methods.name: AddRedisGrainStorage (overload)
methods.description: Configures Redis as a named grain storage provider with optional configuration builder.
